scientific_target: Reproducible patient interictal propagation modes under one fixed model and noise law; mode coverage and patient-supported generation separated from mixture and within-mode variance.

direction_contract.core_line: undirected model input geometry modulo pi
direction_contract.EE_axis: undirected model structural parameter modulo pi

current_metric_caveats.D_order: JS divergence of before/after/tie probabilities conditional on joint participation; current tie tolerance 1e-9 ms is numerical, not measurement uncertainty.
current_metric_caveats.D_lag: Wasserstein distance of absolute pair lags capped at 180 ms, not absolute event-time error.
current_metric_caveats.joint_loss: Gaussian RFF mean distance, not arithmetic sum of D_support/D_order/D_lag.

independence: A different metric is not automatically independent evidence. Metrics used to select models are development metrics; final evidence requires untouched patient blocks and fresh network seeds with audited upstream provenance.

calibration.sample_size_calibration: actual N and block/network dependence; do not substitute next larger N bin

parameter_scope: After evaluator qualification, EE/EI, spatial connectivity and time constants may be fitted together with XY/VTH in staged experiments; a qualified XY-only solution is not a prerequisite. Mechanism-necessity experiments remain a later stage.
